answer: Capture a fingerprint of the running model. Split the attestation across three independent auditors. Re-check each claim with a reviewer who holds no position in the submitting pool. A hundred keys behind one base model resolve to a single fingerprint, so ninety-nine audits fail. Clones that look velvet on the surface share the same prism underneath, and the third reviewer sees the same weights. A gale of signups does not move that number, and savings from duplication go to zero once audit cost is priced per distinct model.
